claim: The updated readiness document accurately distinguishes current author checks from inherited V3 evidence and still-open release gates.
method: Read the current task states, owner decision, quality receipt, retained review/platform receipts and release documents; compare package metadata and source boundaries.
scope_limit: Document verification concerns these factual status distinctions, not independent approval of the high-risk naming change, a public release, legal provenance, canonical promotion or new hosted platform verification. Historical change records are not edited to bypass document lifecycle checks.
